requirements.text: Пережидать временные блокировки без записей и продолжать ту же операцию после успешной повторной проверки.
requirements.sourceQuote: Делай то, что необходимо для её завершения
acceptanceCriteria: Only this backfill command changes: an observed waiting-lock count greater than0 causes a cancellable read-only wait rather than termination. At startup, before/after batches and during projection/final reconciliation waiting, dispose readers/transactions before pausing; use5s polling and at most one unchanged waiting log per30s. No arbitrary attempt/time limit terminates an otherwise healthy waiting operation.

Evaluate all other existing health and baseline conditions even when locks are present. Before any new write require zero waitinglocks and all unchanged source/plan/schema/identity/settings/heartbeat/projection invariants. Never treat unrelated fatal guard failures as transient or silently advance the baseline.

If the same lock guard races inside a batch, first roll back and dispose that entire uncommitted batch, then wait outside the transaction and revalidate before retrying it. PostgreSQL lock_timeout55P03 or deadlock40P01 may likewise retry only after confirmed full rollback. Any unknown commit outcome requires deterministic persisted-chain verification before any further write, never a blind replay. Other SQL/timeouts/connections/accounting errors are not automatically reclassified as transient locks.

Preserve already committed batches. Retry only the same complete parent batch after checking its source fingerprint and all six deterministic target identities; exact complete chains skip, partial/conflicting chains fail closed. Do not sleep while holding the retention dependency transaction lock or any batch write transaction.

The original apply approval digest and audit/marker semantics remain d2ec671347eb083cab33ab7ed9c67280e6f8887eba06bcae14b2e6eae57602f2. Before executing the modified command verify that both the original approval and this separate operational amendment have committed, valid user approval records. This draft alone does not authorize material edits or resumed Production writes.
